Process.title: From idea to spin-off
Process.intro: Eight stations take a project from its first pitch to spinning off as an independent company.

kickOff.title: Kick-off
kickOff.short: We give the starting signal and pass on the knowledge you need for ideation and project work.

ideation.title: Ideation phase (InnoLab)
ideation.short: As a team, you and others develop a problem-solution fit for a problem you actually care about.

innoGating.title: Inno-Gating
innoGating.short: The board and advisors assess how feasible your idea is and decide whether you can move on to the MVP phase.

mvp.title: MVP phase
mvp.short: Your team develops a detailed business plan, a brand, and a prototype or pilot project.

operationsGating.title: Operations-Gating
operationsGating.short: The board and advisors assess your progress again. If your plan and execution convince us, we're ready to take you on as a real project.

implementation.title: Project phase
implementation.short: Your team puts your plan into practice, without carrying the personal risk.

spinoff.title: Legal gating/spin-off
spinoff.short: If spinning off is the project's goal, it can happen once the project's success is stable.

startup.title: Startup
startup.short: The project then stands on its own, for example as its own company, independent of the association.

guide.title: Project Guide
guide.lead: The full process as a PDF, to read at your own pace, with everything explained in more detail.

smilegreen.oneLiner: An uncompromisingly sustainable toothbrush that is 100 % hygienic at the same time.
smilegreen.description: We are developing an uncompromisingly sustainable toothbrush that is 100 % hygienic at the same time. Our material composition, natural rubber transformed into a high-performance elastomer, PHA and bio-PE, is what makes sustainable brushing hygienic.

mealyo.description: Mealyo is building an app that cuts food waste by digitising the food you already have at home. Scan your receipt and you're done. When something is about to spoil, the app suggests recipes that use it up.

resoap.oneLiner: Used cooking oil becomes high-quality soap.
resoap.description: ReSoap gives used cooking oil a second life, turning it into high-quality soap. Instead of burdening the environment and the sewer system as waste, the oil becomes the raw material for something new and sustainable.

impactwithus.oneLiner: Social media consulting for NGOs that raises donation income through greater visibility.
impactwithus.description: ImpactWithUs is a social media consultancy for NGOs that raises donation income through greater visibility. For existing clients, IWU runs social media workshops, advisory work and content management.

hero.title: Your way in, with an idea.
hero.lead: The InnoLab is where your own idea becomes a real project. With weekly sessions, team support, and access to our advisor network, you build out your concept and become a member of Enactus Mannheim along the way.
hero.languageNote: The InnoLab's weekly sessions and mentoring take place in German. This page explains what to expect in English.

paths.title: Two entry paths, one destination.
paths.lead: Whether you joined the Ideathon or bring your own idea, the path ends in the same InnoLab.

ideathon.title: Via the Ideathon
ideathon.description: Four days, one fixed team, one idea through to the final pitch. Sign-up runs separately from the InnoLab and doesn't lead to membership automatically.
ideathon.bullet2: Sign up solo or as a ready-made team
ideathon.bullet3: Three workshops on ideation, business modelling, and pitching

ownIdea.title: With your own idea
ownIdea.description: You have an idea or a problem that keeps you thinking. In the InnoLab you work on it in weekly sessions and become a member of Enactus Mannheim along the way.

steps.title: Five steps to your concept.
steps.lead: Every step builds on the last. At the end is a pitch in front of the InnoLab.
steps.regionLabel: The five steps of the solo path

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.description: Understand what social entrepreneurship can look like, with real examples and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals as a frame. By the end you know which topics genuinely grab you.

problemUnderstanding.title: Understanding the problem
problemUnderstanding.description: A general interest becomes a concrete problem. Using the 5 Whys method, you dig down to the root and write a precise problem statement.

ideationMarketAnalysis.title: Ideation and market analysis
ideationMarketAnalysis.description: One problem becomes many ideas, using techniques like Crazy 8s and SCAMPER. By the end you score them on impact and feasibility and pick your strongest.

businessModelOutline.title: Business model outline
businessModelOutline.description: Your idea on one page: nine fields from problem and target group to channels and costs. The foundation for everything that follows.

pitchInnoGate.title: Pitch and Inno Gate
pitchInnoGate.description: You present your concept at an InnoLab session. If your pitch convinces us, you get the Inno Gating and move into the MVP process.

inside.title: Inside the InnoLab
inside.lead: Your idea becomes a project, with structure, rhythm, and support.

weeklySessions.title: Weekly sessions
weeklySessions.description: Fixed dates where teams work together, pitch, and get feedback.

advisorAccess.title: Advisor access
advisorAccess.description: Experienced mentors from business and academia are there for you and your team, for strategic questions or a second opinion.

innoGating.title: Inno Gating
innoGating.description: If your pitch convinces us, you get the Inno Gating and move into the MVP phase. More on that on our process page.

boundary.title: Two sign-ups, one goal.
boundary.lead: The two formats belong together, but you sign up for them separately.

innolab.title: For the InnoLab
innolab.description: You apply through the membership form, join the weekly sessions, and become a member of Enactus Mannheim.

ideathon.title: For the Ideathon
ideathon.description: You sign up separately. You do not have to join the association for it, you can simply take part.

boundary.closingNote: The two still fit together. If you were at the Ideathon, you bring a developed idea and a team that already works into the InnoLab. So we would be glad to see you at both.

after.title: The InnoLab is the beginning.
after.lead: As your project matures in the InnoLab, it keeps going, through the Inno Gating into the MVP phase and, over time, to spinning off as an independent company.
after.processNote: The complete path is described on our <processLink>process page</processLink>, eight stations from the first pitch to your own company.

bringOwnIdea.question: Do I need to already have a finished idea?
bringOwnIdea.answer: No. All that matters is your willingness to work through the five steps.

differenceFromIdeathon.question: What's the difference between the Ideathon and the InnoLab?
differenceFromIdeathon.answer: The Ideathon is a one-off, compact format in autumn with teams formed on the spot. The InnoLab runs all year in weekly sessions. How sign-up differs between the two is explained above, under InnoLab and Ideathon.

pitchNotConvincing.question: What if my idea doesn't convince at the pitch?
pitchNotConvincing.answer: No problem. You get honest feedback and two options: keep developing the idea, or work on a new one. Either way, the association stays open to you.

whatToStudy.question: What should I study for this?
whatToStudy.answer: Anything. We deliberately mix teams across degree programs, business, engineering, social sciences, and design students all complement each other.

cost.question: Does it cost anything?
cost.answer: No. Taking part in the InnoLab and the whole process is free for students.

contact.title: Have a question?

closing.lead: A short form is all it takes, then we'll invite you to the next InnoLab session.

bringOwnIdea.question: Do I need to bring an idea already?
bringOwnIdea.answer: No. Many people come with no idea, or just a rough thought. You develop the idea with your team during the Ideathon, and the ideation workshop helps with that.

allFourDays.question: Do I need to be there all four days?
allFourDays.answer: Yes. The program builds on itself and your team is counting on you. If you can't make all four days, exceptions may be possible. Reach out via the contact.

cost.question: What does it cost to take part?
cost.answer: Nothing. Participation, food, drinks, workshops, and materials are all free, made possible by our partners.

overnight.question: Do I need to stay overnight?
overnight.answer: No. We work during the day and evening; you go home in between and sleep in your own bed.

afterIdeathon.question: What happens after the Ideathon?
afterIdeathon.answer: If you want to keep working on your idea, you're welcome to join the association, with structure, advisors, and a team behind you. The best teams get the Inno Gating on Ideathon pitch day and can then keep working in the MVP process within the association, gaining access to €500, our network, and business advisors. Our <innolabLink>InnoLab page</innolabLink> shows exactly what that path looks like.

what-is-enactus.question: What is Enactus Mannheim e.V.?
what-is-enactus.answer: Enactus Mannheim e.V. is a registered student association that tackles social and environmental problems with entrepreneurial approaches. Inside our projects, an idea is developed and scaled all the way into a working business.

what-are-social-startups.question: What are social start-ups?
what-are-social-startups.answer: For a social start-up, the social impact of the business comes first. The goal is to solve an environmental or social problem and turn a profit while doing it.

what-work-looks-like.question: What would my work at Enactus look like?
what-work-looks-like.answer: If you join a project, your work depends heavily on that project. In the InnoLab you take part in the regular sessions and develop ideas as a team until you find the one you want to pursue. In a department, you take charge of one organisational area of running the association instead.

time-commitment.question: How much time should I expect to put in?
time-commitment.answer: Being part of Enactus isn't only work. It's shared memories and the friends you make along the way, so not every hour together is work. Expect roughly 8–10 hours a week across socials and your project, InnoLab or department. We ask for commitment, but we're understanding when something comes up. During exam season the workload is reduced as far as possible.

own-project.question: Can I pursue an idea of my own?
own-project.answer: Absolutely. Every one of our projects starts with an idea to make the world better. Apply for the InnoLab and we'll help you work it out. Already well into business modelling? The route still runs through the InnoLab, where we support you at your own pace.

language.question: Do I need to speak a particular language?
language.answer: Association and project work happen in German. That is the working language of the club. Other languages are useful, but not required.

switch-project.question: Can I switch to a different project?
switch-project.answer: If things aren't working out, you can go to your project lead and the C&C board at any point and find a solution together, moving to another team, for instance.

spin-off.question: Can I spin my project out of Enactus Mannheim?
spin-off.answer: Yes, gladly. Enactus offers you all the help and advice you need to spin your start-up out.

team-size.question: How many people are in a project?
team-size.answer: It depends heavily on what the project needs. Most projects start out in the ideation phase with 3–4 members and grow to 5–15 once they reach the project phase.

project-tasks.question: What could I work on inside a project?
project-tasks.answer: The tasks are varied and always depend on where the project currently stands, building prototypes, project trips, pitching, writing the business plan. We try to put your interests and strengths where you and the team get the most out of each other, without losing the fun of it.

application-window.question: When can I apply?
application-window.answer: There is an application window of roughly two weeks at the start of each semester. The “Mitmachen” page shows the next window and explains how the process works.

who-can-join.question: Who can join the team?
who-can-join.answer: You need to be enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences. Your subject doesn't matter. Our projects live off teams that bring different disciplines and perspectives together.

requirements.question: What do I need to bring?
requirements.answer: What we expect from you is set out on the “Mitmachen” page.

choose-position.question: Can I choose my own project or department?
choose-position.answer: You can apply with three ranked preferences for the work you'd like to do. We then offer you the highest-ranked position we can. If none of the three works out but you convinced us in person, we'll invite you in for a conversation.

moritz-knabe.quote: To me, ENACTUS is entrepreneurship with purpose. It shows what it looks like to make the world a better place.

pauline-machtolf.role: Head of Business Development at GoodJobs
pauline-machtolf.quote: Enactus Mannheim always feels like coming home to a warm, cross-generational family.

alexander-mueller.role: PhD candidate at the Chair of Marketing and Innovation
alexander-mueller.quote: I'm looking forward to new projects with Enactus Mannheim and working together with the whole team.

cornelius-bossers.role: Vice President Global Sales Excellence at Freudenberg
cornelius-bossers.quote: We're currently one of the top 16 Enactus teams worldwide, passion, entrepreneurial spirit, and great projects. That's Enactus Mannheim.

STAR_1.description: Blauherz developed trousers for wheelchair users that combine functional and fashionable demands. The project ran from 2016 to its spin-off in 2019 and was also a 2019 World Cup finalist.

STAR_2.description: Moufense is an anti-mosquito body lotion against malaria in Togo, its effectiveness confirmed by the Biogents institute in Regensburg. Distribution ran through the Kopeme Group; the project won the National Cup in 2021.

STAR_3.description: effishent ran aquaponics in Togo, the symbiotic farming of fish and vegetables in a closed water cycle. The process was designed to be affordable for developing countries too.

STAR_4.description: Sanagua gave the population of Arica, Chile, access to clean and affordable drinking water. The project was successfully spun off.

STAR_5.description: Afya fought malnutrition in Uganda with the algae spirulina, building its own local production with local distribution partners.

STAR_6.description: Differgy advises companies on integrating autistic employees into the workforce long term, from the job posting through the application process to onboarding. The project was successfully spun off and now operates as an independent inclusion consultancy.

STAR_8.description: Sunte brought solar power and education to hospitals in Togo.

scope.title: Scope
body: This policy describes which personal data we process when you visit this website, for what purpose, on what legal basis, and for how long we keep it.

It applies to every page on this website, including the application form, the application-start notification, and the contact form. Linked third-party websites, for instance our projects, partners, or Enactus Germany, have their own privacy policies.

responsible.title: Controller
responsible.intro: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
responsible.noDpo: Enactus Mannheim e. V. has not appointed an in-house data protection officer; the statutory conditions requiring one are not met.

hosting.title: Hosting and server logs
hosting.intro: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, USA, and served from the Frankfurt am Main location (region "fra1").
hosting.fieldsIntro: Loading a page processes technically necessary access data:
fields: IP address of the requesting device
date and time of access
the address requested and the amount of data transferred
the server's status message
the referring page, where transmitted
browser type, browser version, and operating system
hosting.purpose: This data is technically required to deliver the website and serves operational security and defence against attacks. We do not combine it with any other data source.
hosting.legalBasis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in providing the website securely, stably, and reliably.
hosting.retention: Vercel deletes these logs automatically after a short time; we do not evaluate them on a personal basis and keep no permanent copies.

database.title: Database
body: We store applications, contact messages, and application-start notification sign-ups in a Postgres database from provider Neon Inc., USA. The database runs in the "eu-central-1" region (Frankfurt am Main), so the data stays within the European Union.

The CV is not stored in the database, but separately in a private file store (Vercel Blob, Frankfurt am Main region). It can only be retrieved there after authenticating through the password-protected board area. In addition, the CV is transmitted once as an attachment to the notification email sent to the board, and from then on also resides in its email inbox.
We collect only what a given purpose requires, and delete it once that purpose no longer applies (Art. 5(1)(c) and (e) GDPR). The specific periods are in the "Retention" section.

email.title: Email delivery
body: We use Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc., USA) to send automatically generated emails. These include the application confirmation, the forwarding of contact inquiries, the application-start notification confirmation, and notifications to the board about received applications, Ideathon signups, and contact inquiries, including any file attachments sent with them. Sending happens from the Ireland region ("eu-west-1"), within the European Union.

We transmit the recipient's email address, the sender's email address, and the content of the respective message. For notifications about received applications, we additionally transmit the attached files, that is, the application details as a PDF and, if provided, the uploaded CV.

Our emails carry no open tracking, no click tracking, and no tracking pixels. Those features are deliberately switched off on our account. Links in our emails go straight to their destination and are never redirected through an intermediary service.
email.legalBasis: The same basis as the underlying request. See the application, application-start notification, and contact-form sections.

analytics.title: Analytics
body: We use Vercel Analytics for anonymous evaluation of page views. The service sets no cookies, stores no identifiers on your device, and builds no cross-device profiles. We only collect aggregated figures such as the page viewed, an approximate country-level region, device type, and referring page.

This gives us no way to identify individual people. Because no information is stored on or read from your device, no consent under § 25 TDDDG (the German cookie-consent law) is required. That's why this website shows no cookie banner.
analytics.legalBasis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in understanding which content is used, so we can improve the website.

externalContent.title: Fonts and external content
externalContent.fontsBody: Every font is embedded locally on our own server. There is no connection to Google Fonts or any other external font provider; your IP address is never transmitted to a third party for this.
videoBody: We embed project pitches and similar videos behind a click-to-load preview. Before you click, no connection to YouTube is made, no data is transmitted, and no cookies are set. Only a preview image served from our own server is shown.

Only once you click the preview image does the embedded player load from the youtube-nocookie.com domain. From that point on, Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland, processes your data under its own responsibility; Google's privacy policy applies. We have no influence over the nature or extent of that processing.
externalContent.legalBasis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. You give your consent by deliberately clicking the preview image.

application.title: Application form
application.intro: Through the "Mitmachen" page you can apply for membership. We collect:
fields: first name, last name, email address
degree program, semester
availability in hours per week
up to three prioritized areas of interest, each with its own reason (free text)
up to three departments you would like to work in (optional, no reason required)
CV as a PDF file (upload)
motivation (free text)
previous involvement (free text)
relevant skills for the chosen area of involvement (free text)
what you hope to take from your time at Enactus (free text)
preferred time slots for an interview (optional, multiple selection)
how you heard about us
the time you gave consent
application.cvUpload: Your CV must be uploaded as a PDF file, 4 MB maximum. The file is not scanned for malware; open it with the same care you would any email attachment. We ask you not to include any special category personal data under Art. 9 GDPR in your CV or elsewhere in your application, for instance about health, religious or philosophical belief, political opinion, or sexual orientation, and to leave out a photo, date of birth, nationality, or marital status. Such information is not required for selection.
application.purpose: Reviewing and processing your application, and getting in touch as part of the selection process.
application.legalBasis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR. Processing takes place to carry out pre-contractual measures at your request.
application.access: Your application is stored in our database first. The board of Enactus Mannheim e.V. then receives a notification by email at info@unimannheim.enactus.team. It includes your application details as a PDF file and, if you uploaded a CV, that CV as a second file attachment. The board and the people responsible for processing applications within the association have access to the application and its attachments.
application.necessityLabel: Whether you have to provide it
application.necessity: Providing this data is neither legally nor contractually required. Without the fields marked as mandatory, however, we cannot process your application.

ideathonSignup.title: Ideathon signup
ideathonSignup.intro: Through the "Ideathon" page you can sign up for the Ideathon. We collect:
fields: first name, last name, email address
degree program, semester
motivation and prior experience (free text, optional, capped at 1000 characters)
whether you already have an idea
a short idea description (free text, optional, capped at 1000 characters)
whether you're signing up as a team, team size, and team member names (each optional, team member names capped at 300 characters)
dietary preference from a fixed list (omnivore, vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, no answer)
how you heard about us
the time you read this privacy notice
ideathonSignup.purpose: Organising and running the Ideathon, including team planning, catering, and room capacity.
ideathonSignup.legalBasis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR. Processing is necessary to carry out the event you're registering for with your signup.
ideathonSignup.access: The board and the people responsible for organising the Ideathon within the association. Your signup is stored in our database first, then sent by email to info@unimannheim.enactus.team.
ideathonSignup.necessityLabel: Whether you have to provide it
ideathonSignup.necessity: Providing this data is neither legally nor contractually required. Without the fields marked as mandatory, however, we cannot process your signup.

reminder.title: Application-start notification
body: While the application window is closed, you can sign up to be notified once it opens.
We store your email address, the time you signed up, the time you confirmed, the IP address used for that confirmation, and two randomly generated tokens for confirmation and unsubscribing.

Sign-up uses the double opt-in procedure: after submitting, you receive an email with a confirmation link. We only add you to the list once you confirm. We store the time and IP address of your confirmation as proof of your consent; without that proof, we could not demonstrate the sending was lawful.
reminder.legalBasis: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR for sending, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for storing the proof of consent.
reminder.withdrawal: Every email contains an unsubscribe link that works without any further input. Withdrawal takes effect for the future and does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before it.

contact.title: Contact form
body: Through the "Kontakt" page you can send us a message. We collect your name, email address, a subject, and the content of your message.
contact.legalBasis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in answering inquiries. If your inquiry aims at forming or pursuing a membership or partnership, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR also applies.
contact.alternative: You are of course also welcome to reach us by email directly, without the form.

antiSpam.title: Protection against abuse
antiSpam.intro: To defend against automated bulk submissions, we use the following measures:
measures: a form field invisible to you, filled in only by automated programs
a check of the time between loading and submitting the form
a limit on the number of submissions per sender within a time window
antiSpam.ipHandling: For that limit, we store your IP address only as a cryptographic hash, from which the original address cannot be recomputed. These values are deleted automatically once the respective time window elapses.
antiSpam.noCaptcha: We deliberately do not use a CAPTCHA. It would be a barrier for people with disabilities and would transmit additional data to third parties.
antiSpam.legalBasis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in protecting our systems from abusive use.

retention.title: Retention periods
retention.applicationsValue: {months} months after the respective application period ends
retention.cvValue: {months} months after the respective application period ends, together with the application it belongs to. The copy that resides as an attachment to the notification email in the board's inbox is deleted manually at the same point in time.
retention.contactValue: {months} months after the inquiry is received
retention.note: Statutory retention obligations remain unaffected. Where such an obligation prevents deletion, we restrict processing instead.

processors.title: Processors and recipients
processors.intro: We do not pass on personal data for advertising purposes and do not sell it. Data is transmitted only to the following service providers, who act as our processors under Art. 28 GDPR:
rows: Hosting, delivery, analytics, storage of uploaded application documents
processors.dpaNote: We have data-processing agreements in place with every provider listed.
processors.transfer: The companies listed are based in the United States. Processing itself takes place within the European Union, but access from the USA, for maintenance and support, for instance, cannot be fully ruled out. For that case, we have agreed the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses under Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR with these providers.

automatedDecisions.title: No automated decision-making
automatedDecisions.body: No automated decision-making, including profiling under Art. 22 GDPR, takes place. Decisions about applications are made exclusively by people.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.body: This website is delivered exclusively over an encrypted (TLS) connection. You can recognize this by the lock icon in your browser's address bar. This protects everything you submit through our forms from being read by third parties in transit.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: You have the following rights against us:
list: Access to whether and which data we process about you (Art. 15 GDPR)
Rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data (Art. 16 GDPR)
Data portability in a common format (Art. 20 GDPR)
Objection to processing based on a legitimate interest (Art. 21 GDPR)
Withdrawal of a given consent with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR)
rights.contactPrompt: An informal message is enough to exercise these rights:

complaints.title: Right to complain
complaints.body: Independently of the above, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. The authority responsible for us is:
complaints.authorityName: Der Landesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit Baden-Württemberg
complaints.note: You can also contact the supervisory authority where you live or work.

changes.title: Changes to this privacy policy
changes.body: We update this policy whenever the legal situation, our services, or the nature of our data processing changes. The version published on this page always applies. The date of the last change is at the top of this policy.

fit.title: Bring yourself in.
fit.lead: What we expect, what you get, and why you don't need to bring all of it.

agency.title: Agency
agency.lead: The ability to assess a situation, decide, and act.
agency.detail: We don't expect you to know every answer, just to start when a decision is needed, instead of waiting to be told.

time.title: Real time
time.lead: A noticeable time commitment alongside your studies, especially during intense project phases.
time.detail: Exactly how much depends on your role. Bring it up openly in the interview.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.lead: You own an area and stand behind its outcome.
ownership.detail: Not an internship that runs alongside you. You make operational decisions.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.lead: You work closely with others and take feedback openly.
teamwork.detail: Projects run as a team, not solo. That includes criticism too.

responsibility.title: Responsibility from day one
responsibility.lead: You take on real work, not busywork.
responsibility.detail: You make operational decisions and own the results yourself.

network.title: Network
network.lead: Access to partner companies, alumni, and other Enactus teams worldwide.
network.detail: A network that outlasts your studies.

mentoring.title: Coaching
mentoring.lead: Regular exchange with the board and experienced alumni.
mentoring.detail: You're not alone with decisions. The team's experience backs you up.

growth.title: Practical skills
growth.lead: Skills your degree rarely covers, from sales to legal basics.
growth.detail: Knowledge you need right away, not just theory.

fitNote.lead: You don't need to know it all already
fitNote.detail: Nobody brings everything on day one, and we don't expect that either. What matters is teamwork, curiosity, and the willingness to take on responsibility. You'll learn everything else with us, in the team and on real projects.

contactMessages.title: Contact messages
contactMessages.lead: Incoming enquiries and whether the forward to the mailbox worked. The message text itself lives only in the mailbox.
contactMessages.spamLead: Messages detected as spam. They are stored but were not forwarded to the mailbox. "Not spam" releases a message and forwards it right away. Release only what looks like a genuine enquiry.
contactMessages.notSpamFailed: Releasing did not work. Please try again.
contactMessages.releasedMailFailed: Released, but forwarding failed. The message now appears under "Failed mails" and can be resent there.

reasons.dotted_email: Address with an unusual number of dots

deletionRequests.title: Deletion requests
deletionRequests.lead: For access and erasure requests under GDPR Art. 15 and 17. Search one email address across applications, contact messages, the notification list, and Ideathon signups.
deletionRequests.emailHint: Exactly the address from the request.
deletionRequests.noMatches: Nothing is stored for this address.
deletionRequests.deleteWarning: Deleting is final and cannot be undone. There is no backup these rows would come back from.
deletionRequests.confirmHint: Must match the address you searched for.
deletionRequests.deleted: Deleted: {applications} applications, {contactMessages} contact messages, {reminderSignups} notification-list entries, {ideathonSignups} Ideathon signups.
deletionRequests.errorSearch: The search didn't work. Please try again.
deletionRequests.errorDelete: The deletion didn't work. Please try again.
deletionRequests.errorMismatch: The two addresses don't match. Nothing was deleted.

system.title: System status
system.lead: Whether the cleanup routine is running, whether the database and Resend are reachable, and how many rows are where.
system.cronStale: The cleanup routine hasn't run in over 48 hours, last on {when}. The retention period stated in the privacy policy is currently not being enforced. Check Cron Jobs in the Vercel dashboard.
system.cronNeverRan: The cleanup routine has never run. The retention period stated in the privacy policy is currently not being enforced. Check Cron Jobs in the Vercel dashboard.

resendStatus.invalidKey: RESEND_API_KEY does not look like the expected format.
resendStatus.noAttempts: No send attempt recorded yet ({failed} failed in the last 30 days).
resendStatus.lastFailed: Last send attempt failed on {when} ({failed} failed in the last 30 days).
resendStatus.lastSucceeded: Last send attempt succeeded on {when} ({failed} failed in the last 30 days).

migrationsStatus.outdated: Not applied: last {applied}, expected {expected}. The code assumes columns the database may not have yet. Run npm run db:migrate.

system.rowsUnavailable: Row counts unavailable because the database is unreachable.

AdminError.title: This view couldn't load.
AdminError.note: Usually a database connection issue. Try again, or come back later.

AdminNotFound.title: This admin page doesn't exist.
AdminNotFound.note: Check the link, or head back to the overview.
